# Setu

> Setu (सेतु, "bridge") is a Zig <-> CPython binding layer: ordinary Zig `pub fn`s and structs become a
> CPython extension module, one binary for CPython 3.14, 3.14t, 3.15, 3.15t and later (the stable ABI for
> free-threading, PEP 803), with generated docstrings and a `.pyi` stub. Zig 0.17, Linux. It is the base of
> the Liburing and Shakti projects and is not published on PyPI.

Start with the guide: it has the rules, every parameter type, every class hook signature, and every compile
error Setu raises. The source is the reference behind it; `test/` is a working example of everything.

## Guide

- [docs/setu-guide.md](docs/setu-guide.md): how to write an extension with Setu (read this first)
- [README.md](README.md): what Setu is, the layout, the commands, wheels, docs site, releases

## Source (what to read when the guide is not enough)

- [src/class.zig](src/class.zig): `setu.Class`; the hook table is the file's top comment
- [src/py.zig](src/py.zig): the namespace an extension uses (references, conversions, raising, the module)
- [src/convert.zig](src/convert.zig): `fromPython` / `toPython`, `Buffer`, `Path`, `Sequence(T)` and ownership
- [src/args.zig](src/args.zig): parameters (`Param`, `Rest`, `KwOnly`, `Kwargs`, argument structs)
- [src/export.zig](src/export.zig): `Module`, `exportModule`, the trampolines
- [src/scan.zig](src/scan.zig): what a `Module.from` entry exports, and its filters
- [src/stub.zig](src/stub.zig): how the `.pyi` is derived from the same declarations
- [src/capi.zig](src/capi.zig): the hand-declared C API, with `@compileError` tombstones for what abi3t lacks

## Examples

- [test/setu_classes.zig](test/setu_classes.zig): the model root file (`module`)
- [test/classes.zig](test/classes.zig): one class per hook family
- [test/functions.zig](test/functions.zig): one function per parameter type, constants, enums
- [test/class_test.py](test/class_test.py): what each of those does from Python

## Tools

- [tools/check.sh](tools/check.sh): every check, offline, on all four interpreters
- [tools/setu_build.py](tools/setu_build.py): the PEP 517 wheel backend projects copy
- [tools/setu_docs.py](tools/setu_docs.py): the docs site builder projects copy (stdlib; HTML, `llms.txt`,
  example runner, server); its Wasm logic is [tools/setu_docs_web.zig](tools/setu_docs_web.zig)
- [tools/bench.py](tools/bench.py): per-call cost, A/B against a commit
- [tools/check_coverage.py](tools/check_coverage.py): line coverage under pytest (kcov), run by `zig build
  coverage` (`addCoverageSteps` in `build.zig`)
